evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: Many mined failures are not model errors: a human audit of 100 failures of Qwen3-VL-8B-Instruct on questions generated from COCO and GQA found label errors in 37.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Fine-tuning a vision-language model on its own failures is a direct way to repair it, but accuracy on held-out failures, the obvious measure of success, misleads.
